summary: Ibrexafungerp has a boxed warning in the United States because it can cause harm to an unborn baby [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, produced low risk scores of 48 for the liver and 31 for the heart [M]. Additionally, two clinical trials were stopped, one due to a strategic business choice unrelated to safety or effectiveness, and another because patient sign-ups were too slow during COVID [5][6].
